# PORTING-LADDER — the forensic GnuCOBOL port hierarchy

## Downstream composition

KOBOLD (kobold-data-shim) composes the sealed gnucobol-rs courts into a fixed-record migration-evidence layer; it adds no semantics a lower court has not sealed.

## Non-claims
> The level number is **evidence shape, not quality**; the ladder is **not a completeness claim** (see the missing surfaces in `GNURUST.COVERAGE.1`); it creates **no new truth**.
